name: pgx.context.build
description: Build a bounded traversal context pack from references and optional triples.
maximum_output: hard bounded by max_nodes and max_chars

name: pgx.database.describe
description: Orient the operating LLM to an existing corpus: counts, graphs, pointer grammar, reserved seed pointers, and next actions.

name: pgx.database.initialize
description: Create a fresh Parmesan SQLite knowledge base and return its first operating instructions.
idempotency: filesystem create; overwrite must be explicit

failure_example.condition: The destination already exists and overwrite is false.

name: pgx.database.validate
description: Prove SQLite, identity, revision, graph, reference, registry, triple, FTS, and PGX round-trip invariants.

name: pgx.graph.create
description: Create a graph and its permanent declaration node.
idempotency: request_id replay returns the previously committed result; reuse with different input is rejected
transaction_boundary: single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; all effects commit or all effects roll back
preconditions: graph key, prefix, and pointer are unused
postconditions: declaration is promoted and ordinal zero

request_id.description: Idempotency UUID supplied by the caller.
Idempotency UUID supplied by the caller.

failure_example.condition: The graph key, prefix, or declaration pointer is already used.

name: pgx.manifest.build
description: Generate JSON and optional Markdown manifests from authoritative SQLite state.

name: pgx.node.create
description: Atomically create, validate, index, and assign a promoted PGX node.
idempotency: request_id replay returns the previously committed result; reuse with different input is rejected
transaction_boundary: single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; all effects commit or all effects roll back
preconditions: description satisfies the active bare-pointer link contract
postconditions: one identity, one initial revision, one graph membership, rebuilt references and FTS

request_id.description: Idempotency UUID supplied by the caller.
Idempotency UUID supplied by the caller.

failure_example.condition: The description links to a pointer that does not exist in the active corpus.

name: pgx.node.get
description: Resolve one pointer to its current revision, graph, and tags.

name: pgx.node.search
description: Run bounded SQLite FTS5 search over current promoted nodes.

name: pgx.node.update
description: Create a new immutable revision with optimistic concurrency and atomic reference reindexing.
idempotency: request_id replay returns the previously committed result; reuse with different input is rejected
transaction_boundary: single BEGIN IMMEDIATE transaction; all effects commit or all effects roll back
postconditions: current revision and derived state agree

request_id.description: Idempotency UUID supplied by the caller.
Idempotency UUID supplied by the caller.

arguments.description: A selectively permeable boundary surrounding a cell.

failure_example.condition: expected_revision_uuid is not the current revision.

name: pgx.reference.list
description: List bounded outgoing or incoming natural-language reference occurrences.

name: pgx.reference.make
description: Generate canonical natural-language Markdown whose raw destination is the exact PGX pointer.

failure_example.condition: verify_target is true and the pointer does not exist.

name: pgx.reference.validate
description: Parse and validate bare-pointer Markdown links, exact source positions, and active-corpus targets.
maximum_output: bounded by references in supplied description

result_excerpt.visible_text: The cell membrane bounds the cell.

failure_example.condition: A bare-pointer destination is malformed or unresolved.

name: pgx.serialize.graph
description: Serialize one graph through the reversible escaped PGX grammar.

name: pgx.system.doctor
description: Check whether this conversation environment and an optional corpus are ready for Parmesan.
